article.headline: Greg Jones scores 23 to guide American University to 65-51 victory over Navy
article.description: — Greg Jones scored 23 points as American University beat Navy 65-51 on Monday night, snapping the Midshipmen's eight-game winning streak.
article.linkText: Greg Jones scores 23 to guide American University to 65-51 victory over Navy
article.story: WASHINGTON -- — Greg Jones scored 23 points as American University beat Navy 65-51 on Monday night, snapping the Midshipmen's eight-game winning streak. Jones also had seven rebounds for the Eagles (10-8, 3-2 Patriot League). Wyatt Nausadis scored 17 points while shooting 6 for 10, including 4 for 7 from beyond the arc. The Midshipmen (12-6, 4-1) were led by Cam Cole with 13 points. Austin Benigni added 12 points and Donovan Draper scored 10. American took the lead for good with 18:47 remaining in the first half. The score was 33-17 at halftime, with Jones racking up 10 points. American pulled away with an 8-0 run in the second half to extend a seven-point lead to 15 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
